notes: The New School has no bachelor's program in computer science or computing. Searches of newschool.edu for a CS, computing or data-science bachelor's found only: Eugene Lang College's BA/BS list (Anthropology, The Arts, Culture and Media, Economics, Environmental Studies, Global Studies, History, Interdisciplinary Science, Journalism + Design, Liberal Arts (BA or BS), Literary Studies, Philosophy, Politics, Psychology, Screen Studies, Sociology, Theater, Urban Studies; https://www.newschool.edu/lang/ba-bs-requirements/); the 'Code as a Liberal Art' minor (https://www.newschool.edu/lang/code-as-a-liberal-art); and Parsons design degrees. A minor and individual coding courses are not a CS degree program with a required course sequence, so no C1-C4 frame can be defined and no course layer is collected.
